partners.name: University of Rwanda
partners.description: MSAR is based at the University of Rwanda's College of Science and Technology, where most of our sessions and trainings take place. Our fellowship sessions also bring students together at the Gikondo campus.

partners.name: DATA+ Rwanda
partners.description: Through our collaboration with DATA+ Rwanda, five selected MSAR students took part in professional geospatial data analytics training covering QGIS, Google Earth Engine, Python and practical spatial analysis.

partners.name: Jobra
partners.description: MSAR and Jobra are working together to connect students with career insights, talent profiling, mentorship and industry exposure — starting with a joint career development session in November 2026.
